overview_description.description: Channel VAS is the premium FinTech provider. The company offers airtime credit and airtime advance services, handset loans and big data analytics, all through cutting edge proprietary analytics tools. Channel VAS supports mobile network operators (MNOs) and financial institutions to provide credit daily to people.

about_short_description.short_description: The premium Fintech provider of Mobile Financial Services, Airtime Credit & Airtime Advance Services, Handset Loans and Big Data Analytics

product.name: Micro Lending
product.description: Offers micro and nano lending solutions for quick and convenient loans to individuals and small businesses, integrating seamlessly into partner ecosystems.

product.name: Airtime Advance
product.description: Provides MNOs with airtime, data, and package credit solutions to offer their customers convenient airtime advances.

product.name: Data Monetization
product.description: Employs machine learning to transform MNO data into actionable insights, creating new revenue streams and enhancing customer engagement.

product.name: XTRACASH
product.description: Digital micro lending solution enabling instantly approved loans, disbursed to mobile wallets or bank accounts.

product.name: XTRABALANCE
product.description: An overdraft product allowing wallet users to complete transactions on credit.

product.name: XTRAFONE
product.description: Financing solution for purchasing devices with management capabilities, covering various manufacturers.
